verdict.rationale: Auth0 Actions are tenant-specific, versioned Node.js functions that run within login and identity flows, and they are positioned as the successor to Rules and Hooks. Actions support shared reusable code, and AI tools can deploy them through the official MCP server. Attack protection also acts automatically on events such as breached credentials and repeated failed logins. Missing for 10: an explicit catalog of event triggers (which flow events can fire Actions), event automation beyond identity flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
